order.description:
Order specifies the sorting order of the tags. Given the letters of the
alphabet as tags, ascending order would select Z, and descending order
would select A.

AlphabeticalPolicy.description: AlphabeticalPolicy specifies a alphabetical ordering policy.

acceptedStates.description:
AcceptedStates is a list of BundleDeployment state that are considered acceptable for this dependency.
If the dependency is in one of these states, it will not block the deployment of the dependent bundle.
Valid Values should match the StateRank keys.
If not specified, default to ["Ready"]: only fully ready dependencies are accepted
Example: ["Ready", "Modified"] will accept dependencies that are either ready or have drifted from their desired state.

yaml.description:
YAML options, if using raw YAML these are names that map to
overlays/{name} files that will be used to replace or patch a resource.

kustomize.description:
Kustomize options for the deployment, like the dir containing the
kustomization.yaml file.

defaultNamespace.description:
DefaultNamespace is the namespace to use for resources that do not
specify a namespace. This field is not used to enforce or lock down
the deployment to a specific namespace.

namespace.description:
TargetNamespace if present will assign all resource to this
namespace and if any cluster scoped resource exists the deployment
will fail.

helm.description: Helm options for the deployment, like the chart name, repo and values.

serviceAccount.description: ServiceAccount which will be used to perform this deployment.

createNamespace.description:
CreateNamespace controls whether Fleet creates the target namespace on
downstream clusters during Helm installs. When nil, the default behavior
is to create the namespace (backward-compatible). Set to false by the
controller when Policy requires a ServiceAccount and does not explicitly
allow namespace creation. This does not affect namespaceLabels/
namespaceAnnotations patching, which is always attempted (when set) as
the deployment's ServiceAccount and gated by downstream RBAC.

forceSyncGeneration.description: ForceSyncGeneration is used to force a redeployment

diff.description: Diff can be used to ignore the modified state of objects which are amended at runtime.

keepResources.description: KeepResources can be used to keep the deployed resources when removing the bundle

deleteNamespace.description: DeleteNamespace can be used to delete the deployed namespace when removing the bundle

ignore.description: IgnoreOptions can be used to ignore fields when monitoring the bundle.

correctDrift.description: CorrectDrift specifies how drift correction should work.

namespaceLabels.description: NamespaceLabels are labels that will be appended to the namespace created by Fleet.

namespaceAnnotations.description: NamespaceAnnotations are annotations that will be appended to the namespace created by Fleet.

deleteCRDResources.description: DeleteCRDResources deletes CRDs. Warning! this will also delete all your Custom Resources.

downstreamResources.description:
DownstreamResources points to resources to be copied into downstream clusters, from the bundle's
namespace.

name.description:
Name of target. This value is largely for display and logging. If
not specified a default name of the format "target000" will be used

clusterName.description:
ClusterName to match a specific cluster by name that will be
selected

clusterSelector.description:
ClusterSelector is a selector to match clusters. The structure is
the standard metav1.LabelSelector format. If clusterGroupSelector or
clusterGroup is specified, clusterSelector will be used only to
further refine the selection after clusterGroupSelector and
clusterGroup is evaluated.

clusterGroup.description: ClusterGroup to match a specific cluster group by name.

clusterGroupSelector.description: ClusterGroupSelector is a selector to match cluster groups.

doNotDeploy.description: DoNotDeploy if set to true, will not deploy to this target.

BundleTarget.description: BundleTarget declares clusters to deploy to.

apiVersion.description: APIVersion is the apiVersion of the resource to match.

kind.description: Kind is the kind of the resource to match.

name.description: Name is the name of the resource to match.

namespace.description: Namespace is the namespace of the resource to match.

jsonPointers.description: JSONPointers ignore diffs at a certain JSON path.

operations.description: Operations remove a JSON path from the resource.

ComparePatch.description: ComparePatch matches a resource and removes fields from the check for modifications.

name.description: Name of a resource in the same namespace as the referent.

force.description: Force helm rollback with --force option will be used if true. This will try to recreate all resources in the release.

keepFailHistory.description: KeepFailHistory keeps track of failed rollbacks in the helm history.

comparePatches.description: ComparePatches match a resource and remove fields, or the resource itself from the check for modifications.

DownstreamResource.description: DownstreamResource contains identifiers for a resource to be copied from the parent bundle's namespace to each downstream cluster.

name.description: Name is the name of this target.

clusterName.description: ClusterName is the name of a cluster.

clusterSelector.description: ClusterSelector is a label selector to select clusters.

clusterGroup.description: ClusterGroup is the name of a cluster group in the same namespace as the clusters.

clusterGroupSelector.description: ClusterGroupSelector is a label selector to select cluster groups.

GitTarget.description: GitTarget is a cluster or cluster group to deploy to.

valuesFiles.description: ValuesFiles is a list of files to load values from.

chart.description:
Chart can refer to any go-getter URL or OCI registry based helm
chart URL. The chart will be downloaded.

repo.description: Repo is the name of the HTTPS helm repo to download the chart from.

releaseName.description:
ReleaseName sets a custom release name to deploy the chart as. If
not specified a release name will be generated by combining the
invoking GitRepo.name + GitRepo.path.

version.description: Version of the chart to download

timeoutSeconds.description: TimeoutSeconds is the time to wait for Helm operations.

values.description:
Values passed to Helm. It is possible to specify the keys and values
as go template strings.

templateValues.description:
Template Values passed to Helm. It is possible to specify the keys and values
as go template strings. Unlike .values, content of each key will be templated
first, before serializing to yaml. This allows to template complex values,
like ranges and maps.
templateValues keys have precedence over values keys in case of conflict.

valuesFrom.description: ValuesFrom loads the values from configmaps and secrets.

force.description: Force allows to override immutable resources. This could be dangerous.

takeOwnership.description: TakeOwnership makes helm skip the check for its own annotations

maxHistory.description: MaxHistory limits the maximum number of revisions saved per release by Helm.

waitForJobs.description:
WaitForJobs if set and timeoutSeconds provided, will wait until all
Jobs have been completed before marking the GitRepo as ready. It
will wait for as long as timeoutSeconds

atomic.description: Atomic sets the --atomic flag when Helm is performing an upgrade

disablePreProcess.description: DisablePreProcess disables template processing in values

disableDNS.description: DisableDNS can be used to customize Helm's EnableDNS option, which Fleet sets to `true` by default.

skipSchemaValidation.description: SkipSchemaValidation allows skipping schema validation against the chart values

disableDependencyUpdate.description: DisableDependencyUpdate allows skipping chart dependencies update

conditions.description: Conditions is a list of conditions to be ignored when monitoring the Bundle.

IgnoreOptions.description: IgnoreOptions defines conditions to be ignored when monitoring the Bundle.

semver.description:
SemVer gives a semantic version range to check against the tags
available.

alphabetical.description: Alphabetical set of rules to use for alphabetical ordering of the tags.

ImagePolicyChoice.description: ImagePolicyChoice is a union of all the types of policy that can be supplied.

name.description: Name of the image scan. Unused.

tagName.description: TagName is the tag ref that needs to be put in manifest to replace fields

image.description: Image is the name of the image repository

interval.description:
Interval is the length of time to wait between
scans of the image repository.

secretRef.description:
SecretRef can be given the name of a secret containing
credentials to use for the image registry. The secret should be
created with `kubectl create secret docker-registry`, or the
equivalent.

suspend.description:
This flag tells the controller to suspend subsequent image scans.
It does not apply to already started scans. Defaults to false.

policy.description:
Policy gives the particulars of the policy to be followed in
selecting the most recent image

ImageScanYAML.description: ImageScanYAML is a single entry in the ImageScan list from fleet.yaml.

dir.description:
Dir points to a custom folder for kustomize resources. This folder must contain
a kustomization.yaml file.

path.description: Path is the JSON path to remove. Not needed if Op is "ignore".

Operation.description: Operation of a ComparePatch, usually: * "remove" to remove a specific path in a resource * "ignore" to remove the entire resource from checks for modifications.

name.description: A user-friendly name given to the partition used for Display (optional).

maxUnavailable.description:
A number or percentage of clusters that can be unavailable in this
partition before this partition is treated as done.
default: 10%

clusterName.description: ClusterName is the name of a cluster to include in this partition

clusterSelector.description: Selector matching cluster labels to include in this partition

clusterGroup.description: A cluster group name to include in this partition

clusterGroupSelector.description: Selector matching cluster group labels to include in this partition

Partition.description: Partition defines a separate rollout strategy for a set of clusters.

maxUnavailable.description:
A number or percentage of clusters that can be unavailable during an update
of a bundle. This follows the same basic approach as a deployment rollout
strategy. Once the number of clusters meets unavailable state update will be
paused. Default value is 100% which doesn't take effect on update.
default: 100%

maxUnavailablePartitions.description:
A number or percentage of cluster partitions that can be unavailable during
an update of a bundle.
default: 0

autoPartitionSize.description:
A number or percentage of how to automatically partition clusters if no
specific partitioning strategy is configured.
default: 25%

autoPartitionThreshold.description:
AutoPartitionThreshold is the minimum number of clusters that need to be
present before auto-partitioning is enabled. If the number of target
clusters is less than this value, all clusters will be placed in a single
partition.
default: 200

maxNew.description:
MaxNew is the maximum number of new BundleDeployments that can be created
in a single reconciliation. This limits the rate at which new deployments
are staged when a bundle is first applied to many clusters.
default: 50

partitions.description:
A list of definitions of partitions.  If any target clusters do not match
the configuration they are added to partitions at the end following the
autoPartitionSize.

RolloutStrategy.description: RolloutStrategy controls the rollout of the bundle across clusters.

name.description: Name of a resource in the same namespace as the referent.

range.description:
Range gives a semver range for the image tag; the highest
version within the range that's a tag yields the latest image.

SemVerPolicy.description: SemVerPolicy specifies a semantic version policy.

configMapKeyRef.description: The reference to a config map with release values.

secretKeyRef.description: The reference to a secret with release values.

ValuesFrom.description: Define helm values that can come from configmap, secret or external.

overlays.description:
Overlays is a list of names that maps to folders in "overlays/".
If you wish to customize the file ./subdir/resource.yaml then a file
./overlays/myoverlay/subdir/resource.yaml will replace the base
file.
A file named ./overlays/myoverlay/subdir/resource_patch.yaml will patch the base file.

YAMLOptions.description: YAMLOptions, if using raw YAML these are names that map to overlays/{name} files that will be used to replace or patch a resource.

name.description: Name of the bundle which will be created.

labels.description:
Labels are copied to the bundle and can be used in a
dependsOn.selector.

downstreamResources.description:
DownstreamResources points to resources to be copied into downstream clusters, from the bundle's
namespace.

paused.description: Paused if set to true, will stop any BundleDeployments from being updated. It will be marked as out of sync.

rolloutStrategy.description:
RolloutStrategy controls the rollout of bundles, by defining
partitions, canaries and percentages for cluster availability.

targetCustomizationMode.description:
TargetCustomizationMode controls how targetCustomizations from fleet.yaml
are evaluated. "FirstMatch" (default) stops at the first matching entry.
"AllMatches" applies all matching entries in order, merging them.

targets.description:
Targets refer to the clusters which will be deployed to.
Targets are evaluated in order and the first one to match is used.

dependsOn.description: DependsOn refers to the bundles which must be ready before this bundle can be deployed.

targetCustomizations.description:
TargetCustomizations are used to determine how resources should be
modified per target. Targets are evaluated in order. By default
(FirstMatch) the first one to match a cluster is used for that cluster.
If targetCustomizationMode is set to AllMatches, all matching entries
are merged in order.

imageScans.description:
ImageScans are optional and used to update container image
references in the git repo.

overrideTargets.description:
OverrideTargets overrides targets that are defined in the GitRepo
resource. If overrideTargets is provided the bundle will not inherit
targets from the GitRepo.

description: FleetYAML is the top-level structure of the fleet.yaml file.
